title: Targeted analysis of 5-Fluorouracil and Fluoroacetate in human plasma by automated extraction and LC-HRMS
author: Margaux Billen
materials: Use the protocol below and the compound specific table details (mass and retention time) in Step 32 to evaluate the data and obtain the FAC and 5FU concentrations in the samples analysed: Margaux Billen, Scott G Denham, Joanna P Simpson, Natalie ZM Homer 2023. Using TraceFinder and Excel software to evaluate and report multi-analyte targeted LC-MS data acquired on an ThermoScientific Exploris 240 Orbitrap. protocols.io https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.n92ldm8z7l5b/v1
All solutions (internal standards and calibration standards) are kept at -20°C after preparation until use.

steps.title: Prepare Sample List and Plate Map
steps.instruction: Create a sample list in Microsoft Excel including experimental details and unique identification codes. Complete a plate map for standards and samples, placing them column-wise (maximum 83 samples per batch plus a 10-point calibration curve).

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Standards
steps.instruction: Defrost control pooled human male plasma, calibration standard mixes, internal standards, and samples.

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stock solutions using a PS-100 balance and HPLC grade water, vortexing thoroughly:

substeps.instruction: 13C3-Lactate (1 mg/mL): Weigh ~2 mg into a 7 mL glass vial, add water (e.g., 2 mL for 2 mg).
FAC (1 mg/mL): Weigh ~2 mg into a 7 mL glass vial, add water (e.g., 2 mL for 2 mg); store at -20 °C.
5-FU (1 mg/mL): Weigh ~2 mg into a 7 mL glass vial, add water (e.g., 2 mL for 2 mg); store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Internal Standard and Calibration Dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the stock solutions into glass vials as specified:

substeps.instruction: Internal Standard: Prepare 50 µg/mL (50 µL 1 mg/mL 13C3-Lactate + 50 µL 1 mg/mL 13C3-Pyruvate + 900 µL water) and 5 µg/mL (200 µL of 50 mg/mL Internal Standard Mix + 1800 µL water).
Calibration Standards: Prepare dilutions for 50 µg/mL, 5 µg/mL, 500 ng/mL, and 50 ng/mL.

steps.title: Prepare Mobile Phases and Seal Wash
steps.instruction: Prepare the following solutions in 1L glass bottles:

substeps.instruction: Mobile Phase A: 1 L LC-MS grade H2O + 1 mL LC-MS grade Formic Acid; mix thoroughly.
Mobile Phase B: 1 L LC-MS grade Acetonitrile.
Autosampler Seal Wash: 100 mL LC-MS grade Acetonitrile + 900 mL LC-MS grade H2O; mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Set Up Extrahera Robot
steps.instruction: Initialize the Extrahera liquid handling robot and environment:

substeps.instruction: Turn on air compressor until pressure reaches ~9 bar and enters Standby (green flashing light).
Ensure fume cupboard is on and duct hose is in place.
Boot up Extrahera.
From Maintenance menu, select 'Flush Solvent Inlets' to purge the LC-MS grade Acetonitrile line; discard purged liquid and refill container.
Ensure standard bore solvent tips are in deck positions 1 and 2.
Place a PPT+ plate in deck position 3, ensuring correct orientation and secure fit.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2mL deep well 96 well collection plate (Biotage) and a Waters 2mL 96 well collection plate (marked with project details, placed in carousel position A with well A1 outside).

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL control pooled plasma to calibration standard and blank wells (A1-D2).
Add required amounts of standards to the plasma (pipette standard directly into plasma due to small volumes).
Add 100 µL of each plasma sample to appropriate wells.
Add 20 µL of 5 µg/mL internal standard solution to all wells except Double Blank and Solvent Blank wells.
Seal with 96 well plate sealing film (Merck) and shake for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Perform PPT+ Extraction
steps.instruction: Execute the automated extraction on the Extrahera:

substeps.instruction: Remove plate seal and place sample plate in deck position 4.
Select 'Run Single Method' -> PPT+ extraction method -> 'Prepare Run'.
Select PPT+ plate columns and update tip numbers/locations if needed.
Press Run: The robot loads 300 µL Acetonitrile per well, transfers sample contents, applies positive pressure, and collects eluent in the Waters 2mL deep well plate.
Verify elution solvent volumes are approximately equal and samples were correctly aspirated.

steps.title: Concentrate and Resuspend Samples
steps.instruction: Process the collected eluent using a TurboVap Dual 96 sample concentrator:

substeps.instruction: Dry samples at 40 °C with gas flow of 30 mL/min.
Resuspend dry samples in 80 µL of H2O.
Seal plate with Waters Adhesive plate sealing film.
Shake for 00:10:00 at 600 rpm.

steps.title: Configure LC-HRMS System
steps.instruction: Set up the UPLC and Mass Spectrometry parameters:

substeps.instruction: Install mobile phases and purge lines with A and B.
Install ACQUITY Premier HSS T3 Column (1.8 µm, 2.1 x 150mm) in oven at 40°C; equilibrate at 100% A, 0.3 mL/min for ≥15 minutes.
Create Xcalibur acquisition method with gradient: 0-1 min (100% A, 0.3 mL/min), 1-5 min (5% A, 95% B, 0.3 mL/min), 5-5.6 min (5% A, 95% B, 0.3 mL/min), 5.6-7 min (100% A, 0.3 mL/min).

Set MS parameters: Thermo Exploris 240 Orbitrap, H-ESI source, MRM Negative polarity, Full Scan, 7.0 min acquisition, Sheath Gas 50, Aux Gas 15, Sweep Gas 1, IS Voltage -2500 V, TEM 350°C, Vaporizer 450°C, Probe x=2, y=2.

steps.title: Run Sample Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the prepared samples via LC-HRMS:

substeps.instruction: Place the sealed 96-well plate into the autosampler.
Create a batch in Xcalibur with correct plate position, column, mobile phase lines, and LC-MS/MS method.
Set injection volume to 20 µL.
Inject a mid-standard curve point for system testing, then run the batch from A1 to H12.

steps.title: Data Interrogation
steps.instruction: Interrogate data using the following m/z [M-H]- and retention times:

substeps.instruction: FAC: m/z 77.0044, RT 1.50 min
13C3-Lactate: m/z 92.0345, RT 1.97 min
